squeeze.purpose: Sky-plane image reconstruction from squared visibilities and closure phases (Baron et al.).

rotir.purpose: Surface reconstruction on a tessellated star (ROTIR.jl on OITOOLS.jl), the method Evans et al. (2024) used for Polaris.
rotir.license: ROTIR.jl GPL-3.0; OITOOLS.jl LGPL-3.0; Julia MIT

pionier.purpose: ESO VLTI/PIONIER data reduction and calibration from raw frames (pndrs through esorex), so a star is not limited to the OiDB's automated calibration.

amber.purpose: ESO VLTI/AMBER reduction from raw frames (P2VM, SciCal, frame selection, transfer function), for stars observed only with AMBER.

repair.reason: Apple clang 17 refuses gipaf.c, which calls cx_assert without including cxmessages.h; install_pipeline stops there before unpacking the calibration files.

gravity.purpose: ESO VLTI/GRAVITY reduction from raw frames (dark, P2VM, visibilities, transfer function), driven by the archive's calibration association tree.

matisse.purpose: ESO VLTI/MATISSE reduction from raw frames (flat, shift and kappa maps, raw estimates, calibrated OIFITS), driven by the archive's calibration association tree.

openmp.why: MATISSE 2.5.0 compiles its OpenMP loops out on macOS (#if defined (_OPENMP) && !defined( __APPLE__)), so mat_raw_estimates ran on one core: 759 s for a Betelgeuse LM exposure. With LLVM's OpenMP runtime and the guard removed in these files, 4 threads take 444 to 479 s and peak at 13.3 to 14.6 GB. mat_opd_wvpo.c keeps its guard: threaded, its loops share a status variable and changed the band-edge channel's squared visibility and closure phase. With these files threaded the product equals the single-threaded one except the differential-phase error of that band-edge channel (4.985 um), a bootstrap estimate.

casa.purpose: Calibration and imaging of radio-interferometric visibilities (NRAO CASA), used to restore an ALMA measurement set from its raw ASDM and the pipeline's own calibration tables.
casa.license: casatools and casatasks: LGPL-2.1 or later (NRAO). Not redistributed here; installed from the pinned wheels.
casa.note: casatasks carries the CASA tasks used here (importasdm, flagmanager, applycal, split, tclean). The ALMA pipeline package (hifa_*) is not installed and is not needed: the calibration the pipeline applied is replayed from the calapply record shipped beside the data.
